an8.45:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an8.45:1.2: Atha kho Bojjhā upāsikā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Bojjhaṃ upāsikaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an8.45:2.1: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato Bojjhe uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.45:2.2: Kathaṃ upavuttho ca Bojjhe aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro? 3.
an8.45:2.4: ‘yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharanti,
an8.45:2.5: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmi,
an8.45:2.6: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.45:2.7: Iminā paṭhamena aṅgena samannāgato hoti . . . pe . . .
an8.45:3.1: ‘yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.45:3.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayānā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.45:3.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.45:3.5: Evaṃ upavuttho kho Bojjhe aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.45:4.1: Kīva mahapphalo hoti kīva mahānisaṃso kīva mahāvipphāro? 4.
an8.45:4.2: Seyyathā pi Bojjhe yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtasattaratanānaṃ issarādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreyya, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.45:4.3: Aṅgānaṃ Magadhānaṃ Kāsīnaṃ Kosalānaṃ Vajjīnaṃ Mallānaṃ Cetīnaṃ Vaṃsānaṃ Kurūnaṃ Pañcālānaṃ Macchānaṃ Sūrasenānaṃ Assakānaṃ Avantīnaṃ Gandhārānaṃ Kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an8.45:4.5: Kapaṇaṃ Bojjhe mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāya. 5.
an8.45:5.1: Yāni Bojjhe mānusakāni paññāsa vassāni, Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.45:5.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni pañca vassasatāni Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamānaṃ.
an8.45:5.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Bojjhe vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.45:5.6: Idaṃ kho pana me taṃ Bojjhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.45:6.2: yāni Bojjhe mānusakāni dve vassasatāni . . . pe . . .
an8.45:6.5: soḷasa vassasatāni, Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo,
an8.45:6.8: tena saṃvaccharena dibbāni soḷasa vassasahassāni Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an8.45:6.9: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Bojjhe vijjati, yaṃ idh' ekacco itthi vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an8.45:6.10: idaṃ kho pana me taṃ Bojjhe sandhāya bhāsitaṃ:
an8.45:6.11: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāyā ti.
an8.45:7.1: pāṇaṃ na haññe na cādinnam ādiye
an8.45:7.2: musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā
an8.45:8.1: mālaṃ na dhāraye na ca gandham ācare
an8.45:9.1: Cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā
an8.45:10.3: siṅgī suvaṇṇaṃ atha vā pi kañcanaṃ
an8.45:12.1: Tasmā hi nārī ca naro ca sīlavā
